name: Clock probe: main-hand swings follow the 1.9 s weapon delay for about 30 s
contract: The warrior equips Worn Shortsword (item 25, delay 1900 ms in item_template); with no melee haste
attack_time_ms reads 1900. It is checked before the attack and right before each swing count, so a lasting
haste change fails as SETUP instead of as a count. Unit::Update counts the main-hand attack timer down by each
player update's diff, and Player::Update swings when it reaches zero and resets it to the full 1900 ms,
dropping the overshoot, so consecutive swings are 1900 ms plus at most one world step apart (1900..1925 ms with
a 25 ms step). Counted from the first swing, the k-th later swing needs k * period of game time: 7 of them by
14.4 s (the 8th cannot land before 15.2 s) and 15 by 29.6 s (the 15th is due by 28.9 s even at 1925 ms, the
16th cannot land before 30.4 s). Each count is read a few step ticks after its checkpoint, which keeps both
counts exact for world ticks up to about 75 ms. melee_attack_count counts every main-hand swing packet, misses
included; hit and expertise ratings keep them ordinary. A swing timer fed by real time instead of
fast-forwarded game time, or a wrongly sized world step, changes the counts.
